source: KDD 2023 DCdetector; dual attention, RevIN, multi-scale patching and the softmax(-series_loss - prior_loss) energy are transcribed from github.com/DAMO-DI-ML/KDD2023-DCdetector (model/DCdetector.py, model/attn.py, model/embed.py, solver.py).
hyperparameter_note: Windows and anomaly ratios come from the repository's own per-dataset scripts (SMD 105/patch 5-7/ratio 0.6, MSL 90/3-5/1.0, SMAP 105/3-5-7/0.85, PSM 60/1-3-5/1.0, SWaT 105/3-5-7/1.0); argparse receives those as digit strings, so the digit list is the patch-size list.
